about: LEADER (NCT01179048) Agent 1 IR, target arm, copied verbatim from a read-only cache. Its flat inclusion rules are what the removed Pattern E repair (inventory A2) merged into 'Cv Prior (OR group)' and 'Cv Risk (OR group)'.

inclusion_rules.name: Age >= 50 years AND (CV/Cerebrovascular/Peripheral Vascular Disease OR Chronic Renal Failure OR Chronic Heart Failure) OR (Age >= 60 years AND Other Specified Risk Factors)
inclusion_rules.source_text: Age min. 50 years at screening and concomitant cardiovascular, cerebrovascular or peripheral vascular disease or chronic renal failure or chronic heart failure OR age min. 60 years at screening and other specified risk factors of cardiovascular disease

inclusion_rules.source_text: Anti-diabetic drug naive or treated with one or more oral anti-diabetic drugs (OADs) or treated with human NPH insulin or long-acting insulin analogue or premixed insulin, alone or in combination with OAD(s)
